acceptance.description: Media uploads enforce supported types, size and alternative text; failed metadata writes are recoverable
acceptance.evidence: Nine focused media tests cover upload text/type/signature/size limits, bounded multipart parsing and compensation/lost acknowledgments.

acceptance.description: Only publishers change visibility; private assets are inaccessible publicly and unpublishing revokes future requests
acceptance.evidence: Service tests verify editor/publisher boundaries, no-store public bytes, revocation, stale/concurrent visibility checks and audit failure. Isolated built-app browser upload/publish/unpublish passed.

acceptance.description: Metadata schema/private bucket and isolated real storage upload/download/cleanup verified
acceptance.evidence: Provisioned only private media collection/attributes/index; private bucket flags/limits verified. Real synthetic PNG upload/private metadata/byte-identical download/anonymous denial passed; both records removed.

acceptance.description: First-day subdomain guide covers DNS, safe TLS bootstrap, process persistence, login, smoke checks and rollback
acceptance.evidence: Certificate-only HTTP bootstrap, final HTTPS vhost with React Router data/manifest paths and complete runbook written. All 13 shell command blocks pass bash syntax. Actual nginx -t/DNS/TLS/reboot remain VPS gates.

acceptance.description: Feature tests, typecheck/build and continuation notes reflect actual verification
acceptance.evidence: Final session:verify passed typecheck, all 57 tests and production build. Isolated browser and live synthetic storage checks passed. Vault links, source credential scan, Git whitespace and all 13 runbook shell blocks checked. Nginx/VPS checks remain explicitly separate.
